data.title: LIV LUX
data.about:
Discover a brand-new style of ultra-luxury seaside living with apartments ranging from 1 to 2 bedrooms, signature apartments ranging from 2 to 4 bedrooms, and super lux penthouses. Located in Dubai Marina, Liv Lux is in one of the world’s most desirable neighborhoods.

Luxury living is paired with 5 Star amenities, a spectacular waterfront location, and premium fixtures, fittings, and finishes in Liv Lux. You will immediately feel pampered at Liv Lux, with a huge 5-star hotel-style foyer and 24 hour valet service.

location_tile.title: Luxury Comes to Dubai Marina
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
A gorgeous Arabian Gulf lies between Liv Lux and the contemporary elegance of Dubai Marina.These apartments are within a short walk from a variety of dining, shopping, and entertainment options.

  • Palm Jumeirah – 05 mins
  • Mall of the Emirates – 07 mins
  • Atlantis Aquaventure – 09 mins
  • Dubai Hills Mall – 10 mins
  • Dubai Parks & Resorts – 15 mins
  • Dubai International Airport – 22 mins
  • Al Maktoum International Airport – 22 mins
